verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs confirm a shared, serverless 'Model APIs' offering with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, token billing, and routing across hosted and external models (baseten-docs-1, baseten-docs-30, baseten-docs-39, baseten-docs-44), which matches the general shape of the story. However, no evidence in the pack names specific open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS, etc.) actually available on these serverless endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit catalog listing of supported model families, breadth/currency of that catalog, and any confirmation these specific models run on shared (non-dedicated) infrastructure.
